Although there is still much to learn, effective treatment is 
now available for the majority of these patients. Restoring ade-
quate energy production through nutritional, hormonal, and 
sleep support, and eliminating the stresses that overuse energy 
(e.g., infections, situational stresses) restores function in the 
hypothalamic “circuit breaker” and also allows muscles to re-
lease, thus allowing pain to resolve. A placebo-controlled study 
showed that with these measures, 91% of patients improve, 
with an average 90% improvement in quality of life, and the 
majority of patients no longer qualified as having FMS by the
